warnings: B2/B3 each print two different rebar layouts (SECTION_1-1 near the support, at L/4-L/5 from the column face, vs SECTION_2-2 at midspan) — a real curtailment pattern, not a duplicate/error, matching the convention already established for this same house series in this batch (house 05). Recorded top/bottom with a note stating which section each count belongs to, per §7.

B4/B10A each carry a genuine two-diameter reinforcement layer on each face (e.g. B4's top shows both '2-DB12' and '2-DB16' as separate leader lines onto the same corner region) rather than a single count — modelled as a constant minimum main_bar (2-DB12 top/bottom for B4) plus an additional_bars entry for the larger bar that switches face between the two sections (curtailed/continuous flexural bar), per the same §7 judgement precedent already used for lap-splice/continuation bars in this batch.
